---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: feature
assignees: TheAnsuz

---

## **Feature**
A description on what you want to be added or changed.

## **Reason**
Some information on why you think this could benefit the project or what is the reasoning of the idea, you can just say "I would love to see this added".

## **Alternatives**
Some features may not be possible to be added, if this is the case, what alternative do you think that could work?
If you don't know any good alternatives, leave this section empty.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. You can leave it empty.
